AI basics quiz for small business owners: 5 questions

No jargon, no trick questions. Just the 5 things that decide whether AI saves you time or creates more work. Keep score and tell me yours in the comments.

The short version:
1) AI can sound sure and still be wrong. Check numbers, laws and dates before you repeat them.
2) Specific beats clever. Say who it's for, what it's about, how long and what tone.
3) Only paste what's already public. Remove names, card numbers and anything private.
4) Don't count on AI remembering your last chat. Re-paste the key details.
5) You can ask it to flag doubts. Add this to any prompt:

"At the end, list anything you're not sure about and what I should check."

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PACK: I'll DM you 21 prompts that put these basics to work.

Save this for later. 📌
